p: write grievousness which they have prescribed: Who write and pronounce a wicked sentence to oppress the people: meaning, that the wicked magistrate, who were the chief cause of mischief, would be first punished.
far: That is, from Assyria.
glory: Your riches and authority, that they may be safe and that you may receive them again.
Without me they shall bow down: Because they have forsaken me, some will go into captivity and the rest will be slain.
Assyrian: God calls for the Assyrians to be the executioners of his vengeance.

him against an hypocritical nation: That is, the Assyrians against the Jews who are hypocrites. In the sixth and seventh verse is declared the difference of the work of God and of the wicked in one very thing and act: for God's intention is to chastise them for their amendment, and the Assyrians purpose is to destroy them to enrich themselves. Thus in respect to God's justice, it is God's work, but in respect to their own malice, it is the work of the devil.
Carchemish: Seeing that I have overcome one city as well as another, so that none could resist, shall Jerusalem be able to escape my hands?
his whole work upon mount Zion: When he has sufficiently chastised his people (for he begins at his own house) then will he burn the rods.
of the king of Assyria: Meaning of Sennacherib.

axe boast itself against him that: Here we see that no creature is able to do anything, but as God appoints him, and that they are all his instruments to do his work though the intentions are diverse, as in Isa 10:6.
fire: Meaning that God is a light to comfort his people and a fire to burn his enemies.
his thorns and his briers in: That is, the Assyrians.
and body: That is, body and soul utterly.
fainteth: When the battle is lost and the standard taken.
lean upon the LORD: This is the end of God's plagues toward his, to bring them to him, and to forsake all trust in others.
decreed shall overflow with righteousness: This small number which seemed to be consumed and yet according to God's decree is saved, will be sufficient to fill all the world with righteousness.
determined: God will destroy this land as he has determined and later save a small portion.
Egypt: As the Egyptians punished you.
Midian at the rock of Oreb: Read Isa 9:4.
sea: When the Israelites passed through by the lifting up of Moses' rod, and the enemies were drowned, Ex 14:28.
the anointing: Because of the promise made to that kingdom, by which Christ's kingdom was prefigured.
Aiath: He describes by what way the Assyrians would come against Jerusalem, to confirm the faithful, when it would come to pass, that as their plague was come, so should they be delivered.
bough with terror: Fear and destruction will come on Judah for the princes and the people will all be led away captive.
